questions.stem: Let \(k\) be a constant such that \(2x^4-kx^3-2x+4\) is divisible by \(2x-k\). Find \(k\).
questions.solution: Write the polynomial as \(x^3(2x-k)-2x+4\). At \(x=k/2\), the remainder is \(-k+4\), so divisibility requires \(k=4\).

Factor each expression:

\((u-7)(u+2)\)

\((u+2)(2u+7)\)

questions.stem:
Let \(f(x)=3x^3-19x^2+16x+24\).

(a) Find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(3x+2\).

(b) Hence factorise \(3x^3-19x^2+16x+20\).

(c) Simplify \(\frac{3x^3-19x^2+16x+20}{9x^3-12x^2-12x}\).
questions.solution:
(a) By the remainder theorem, the remainder is \(f(-\frac23)=4\).

(b) The expression is \(f(x)-4\), so it has factor \(3x+2\). Division gives \[\begin{gathered}x^2-7x+10\\=(x-2)(x-5)\end{gathered}\] Thus it factors as \((3x+2)(x-2)(x-5)\).

(c) The denominator is \(3x(3x+2)(x-2)\). Cancel common factors to obtain \((x-5)/(3x)\), retaining \(x\ne0,-\frac23,2\).

(b) 該式為 \(f(x)-4\)，所以有因式 \(3x+2\)；相除得 \[\begin{gathered}x^2-7x+10\\=(x-2)(x-5)\end{gathered}\]，故分解為 \((3x+2)(x-2)(x-5)\)。

questions.stemZh:

(b) Let \(g(x)=3x^2-7x+2\). Someone claims that \(f(x)=g(x)\) has 3 distinct real roots. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=6x^3+kx^2\\{}-(k-2)x-6\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(k\) 為常數。已知 \(f(x)=(x-2)(ax^2+bx+c)\)，其中 \(a,b,c\) 為常數。

(a) 求 \(a,b,c\)。

(b) 設 \(g(x)=3x^2-7x+2\)。有人聲稱 \(f(x)=g(x)\) 有3個相異實根。你是否同意？解釋。

questions.stem:
Let \(p(x)\) be cubic. Its remainders on division by \(x+1\) and \(x-2\) are \(-1\) and 5 respectively.

(a) Find the remainder when divided by \(x^2-x-2\).

(b) The quotient and remainder are the same when \(p(x)\) is divided by \(x^2-x-2\). Someone claims \(p(x)=0\) has two rational roots. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
設 \(p(x)\) 為三次多項式，被 \(x+1\) 及 \(x-2\) 除時的餘式分別為 \(-1\) 及5。

(a) 求它被 \(x^2-x-2\) 除時的餘式。

(b) 已知 \(p(x)\) 被 \(x^2-x-2\) 除時的商式與餘式相同。有人聲稱 \(p(x)=0\) 有兩個有理根。你是否同意？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Write the remainder as \(Ax+B\). At the divisor roots, \(-A+B=-1\) and \(2A+B=5\). Thus \(A=2,B=1\), giving remainder \(2x+1\).

(b) The quotient is also \(2x+1\). Hence \[\begin{gathered}p(x)=(2x+1)(x^2-x-2)\\+(2x+1)\end{gathered}\]

\(p(x)=(2x+1)(x^2-x-1)\).

The roots are \(-1/2\) and \((1\pm\sqrt5)/2\). Exactly one is rational, so disagree with the claim of two rational roots. The source last sentence says agree, contradicting its own root list; the original question is retained and that answer-key error is corrected.

(b) 商式亦為 \(2x+1\)，所以 \[\begin{gathered}p(x)=(2x+1)(x^2-x-2)\\+(2x+1)\end{gathered}\]

\(p(x)=(2x+1)(x^2-x-1)\)。

questions.stem:
The cubic \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x+2\). When divided by \(x^2-4\), its remainder is \(25x+k\), where \(k\) is a constant.

(a) Find \(k\).

(b) Also \(3x-1\) is a factor, and division by \(x-1\) gives remainder 12. Someone claims \(f(x)=0\) has three distinct real solutions. Is this correct? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x+2\) 整除，被 \(x^2-4\) 除時餘式為 \(25x+k\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。

(a) 求 \(k\)。

(b) 又知 \(3x-1\) 是因式，而被 \(x-1\) 除時餘式為12。有人聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 有三個相異實數解。聲稱是否正確？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Put \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=(Ax+B)(x^2-4)\\{}+25x+k\end{gathered}\] At \(x=-2\), \(0=-50+k\), so \(k=50\).

(b) At \(x=1/3\), the factor condition gives \(A/3+B=15\). At \(x=1\), \(f(1)=12\) gives \(A+B=21\). Thus \(A=9,B=12\).

\(f(x)=9x^3+12x^2-11x+2\).

\(f(x)=(x+2)(3x-1)^2\).

The distinct real solutions are \(-2\) and \(1/3\); the latter is repeated. The claim is incorrect.

When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x-7\), its quotient is \(x^2-hx+k\) and remainder 5. Also \(f(2)=0\) and \(f(-1)=-27\).

(a) Find \(h,k\).

(b) Someone claims all roots of \(f(x)=0\) are rational. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
\(f(x)\) 被 \(x-7\) 除時商式為 \(x^2-hx+k\)、餘式為5，且 \(f(2)=0\)、\(f(-1)=-27\)。

(a) 求 \(h,k\)。

(b) 有人聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 的所有根都是有理數。你是否同意？解釋。

(b) \(f=(x-2)(x^2-7x+1)\). The roots are 2 and \((7\pm3\sqrt5)/2\), including two irrational roots. Disagree.

Let \(f(x)\) be cubic with \(f(2)=30\) and \(f(-3/2)=51\). It is divisible by \(3x^2+4x-5\).

(a) Find the quotient.

(b) How many rational roots does \(f(x)=0\) have? Explain.
questions.solution:
(a) Let \[\begin{gathered}f=(Ax+B)\\{}\cdot (3x^2+4x-5)\end{gathered}\]. The values give \(15(2A+B)=30\) and \[\begin{gathered}(-17/4)\\{}\cdot (-3A/2+B)\\{}=51\end{gathered}\], so \(2A+B=2\) and \(-3A/2+B=-12\). Thus \(A=4,B=-6\), quotient \(4x-6\).

(b) The roots are \(3/2\) and \((-2\pm\sqrt{19})/3\). Only \(3/2\) is rational, so there is one rational root.

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=2x^4+ax^3\\{}+bx^2+x+6\end{gathered}\]. It has factor \(x^2-1\).

(a) Find \(a,b\).

(b) Factorise \(f(x)\).

(c) Solve \(f(x+1)=6x(x-1)\).
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x)=2x^4+ax^3\\{}+bx^2+x+6\end{gathered}\]，且 \(x^2-1\) 是因式。

(a) 求 \(a,b\)。

(b) 因式分解 \(f(x)\)。

(c) 解 \(f(x+1)=6x(x-1)\)。
questions.solution:
(a) \(f(1)=0\) gives \(a+b=-9\); \(f(-1)=0\) gives \(-a+b=-7\). Therefore \(a=-1,b=-8\). The source printed target \(b=8\) has a sign typo; its own worked calculation gives \(-8\).

(b) \[\begin{gathered}f=(x^2-1)\\{}\cdot (2x^2-x-6)\\{}=(x+1)(x-1)\\{}\cdot(2x+3)(x-2)\end{gathered}\].

(c) Substitution and subtraction give \[\begin{gathered}f(x+1)-6x(x-1)\\{}=x(x-1)(x+4)\\{}\cdot(2x+1)\end{gathered}\]. Hence \(x=0,1,-4,-1/2\).
